# ipyfuncs


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

Importing `ipyfuncs` patches `InteractiveShell` with services a kernel
client can call remotely: `user_items`, `get_vars`, `eval_exprs`,
`get_schemas`, `publish`, `ranked_complete`, and `sig_help`. There is no
extension machinery to load – the import is the whole setup. It was
built as the kernel-side half of `conkernelclient`’s `_ipy_funcs`
battery, and needs only `fastcore` and `ipython`.

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/ipyfuncs/):

``` sh
$ pip install ipyfuncs
```

## How to use

Import the package, and the running shell gains the services:

``` python
import ipyfuncs
_vs,_fs = get_ipython().user_items(max_len=15)
list(_fs)
```
